newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - Jan 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - Jan 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Two British nurses accused of killing an Australian colleague were visited by their relatives on Sunday.
- Relatives of a Filipino suspected of murdering an American couple will seek clemency for him if he is fully charged with the murder, ambassador says.
- Riyadh governor to open King Fahd Library on Tuesday.
- Exports in Jubail industrial sea port increased by 3.15 percent in 1996, chairman says.
